finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful advantage over base, pooled and donor rivals is excluded under both interval methods. Primary performance is worse than pooled only under writer resampling; its crossed interval and every other primary interval include zero. Useful uniform advantage is excluded under writer resampling but remains unresolved under crossed resampling. Residual donor useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods and residual pooled only under crossed resampling; residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both, with all residual intervals including zero. Raw base useful advantage is excluded only under writer resampling. Raw pooled and donor useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods: their writer intervals favor personal adaptation at zero but neither clears the useful margin or survives crossed resampling at zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Additional passes repeat existing text; they do not add personal information. Sparse histories, calibration-selected rank, shared human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the recipe. No independent human confirmation, epoch ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
